name: EcoScout
tagline: Scan a product to get an eco score with CO2, water and recyclability, plus greener alternatives.
problem: Products' environmental costs are hidden from shoppers.
solution: Barcode or name lookup produces a 0–100 score across footprint, recyclability, water and sourcing, suggests alternatives and tracks your savings; built with an AI app builder.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a product and compare alternatives.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best integration with Base44” among 122 submissions.
Built on the sponsor's platform end to end.

lessons: Sponsor-platform prizes reward building everything on it.
